items_amounts_ck.name: items_amounts_ck
items_amounts_ck.value: ("items"."purchase_price" is null or "items"."purchase_price" >= 0) and ("items"."sale_price" is null or "items"."sale_price" >= 0) and ("items"."min_level" is null or "items"."min_level" >= 0)

journal_entries_posted_ck.name: journal_entries_posted_ck
journal_entries_posted_ck.value: "journal_entries"."status" = 'draft' or ("journal_entries"."entry_no" is not null and "journal_entries"."posted_at" is not null)

stock_counts_posted_ck.name: stock_counts_posted_ck
stock_counts_posted_ck.value: "stock_counts"."status" = 'draft' or ("stock_counts"."count_no" is not null and "stock_counts"."posted_at" is not null)

stock_movements_shape_ck.name: stock_movements_shape_ck
stock_movements_shape_ck.value: ("stock_movements"."kind" = 'qty' and "stock_movements"."qty" <> 0 and ("stock_movements"."value" = 0 or sign("stock_movements"."qty") = sign("stock_movements"."value"))) or ("stock_movements"."kind" = 'cost_adjust' and "stock_movements"."qty" = 0 and "stock_movements"."value" <> 0)
